messages:
maya: Quick prototype for an econ mini-card — shows per-model unit cost, cache savings, and latency-adjusted effective cost. Dropping a screenshot + CSV in thread. Thoughts on using sessionized vs request-level aggregation? cc @sam @jordan

sam: Nice. Can we get per-route breakdowns too? Want to compare canary vs stable side-by-side.

jordan: Product POV — prefer sessionized by default to reduce noise, but allow request-level on hover/expand. We need to surface spike alerts for anomalous token spikes.

lee: Runtime note — cache credits aren't uniform. KV hit probability depends on prefix length + model. Any sampling needs to preserve that distribution or it'll bias savings.

ria: From telemetry: we can join token-level logs to model_sku + cache_hit. Sample query to get baseline:

```
SELECT model_sku, route, count(*) AS token_count,
       sum(CASE WHEN is_cache_hit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cache_hits
FROM token_telemetry
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```

maya: thanks. Proposal for "amortized cache savings": savings = (cache_hits / token_count) * avg_token_cost * token_weight. alpha tunable by route.

sam: UX asks: add toggle between per-token and per-inference, and a sticky-routing filter (show only traffic pinned to Dedicated vs Hosted).

lee: ops: also expose fallback counts. If routing falls back (model_variant mismatch) we see double token accounting; card should surface fallback tokens and fraction of traffic.

maya: rollout UX idea — show current canary cost delta % (sparkline + absolute $), and action button: "pause rollout if delta > X%" with auto-notify to the canary owners.

jordan: also want quick links from the card to suggested mitigations (apply quantization profile, enable cache priming, tighten max_tokens).

ria: telemetry caution — add a 'confidence' metric: if token_count < 1000, label as low confidence. Also record sampling_rate and provenance to allow auditors to reproduce.

sam: +1. include a provenance link to the raw telemetry query and to the eval prompt set used for quality gating.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: econ-mini-card/v2 -> staging (requested by maya) :rocket:

maya: I'll iterate on the mock and post screenshots + CSV export. Thanks all :heart:
